WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberKai_Te.after: My float keeps bobbing when the\nships go by! Can your team stay\psteady?$
Whoa! My float did a flip!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberKai_Te.before: VERMILION HARBOR has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberKai_Te.after: I count the ripples after each\nboat. The little ones always\pcatch up!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberKai_Te.before: Back on VERMILION HARBOR?\nThen we battle again!$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberKai_Te.after: I stayed upright through three\nwakes! Now for your POKéMON!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberMina_T.after: I found a shell shaped like a\ntiny shield! My team wants to\ptest it.$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberMina_T.before: VERMILION HARBOR has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberMina_T.after: I put the shells back when I'm\ndone. Someone small might need a\phome.$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberMina_T.before: Back on VERMILION HARBOR?\nThen we battle again!$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTuberMina_T.after: Look, another shield shell! This\ntime we have a plan!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanOt.after: I lower my line beside the\nmooring posts. No need for a\pfancy cast. Show me your\ntechnique!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanOt.before: VERMILION HARBOR has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanOt.after: A still float isn't always a bad\nsign. Sometimes the fish are\pstudying you.$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanOt.before: Back on VERMILION HARBOR?\nThen we battle again!$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanOt.after: Same old rod, new trick. Watch\nthe tip!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanVa.after: The forest runoff meets salt\nwater here. I never know what\pwill bite next!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanVa.before: VERMILION HARBOR has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanVa.after: I note each catch with the tide.\nEven familiar fish choose\pdifferent water.$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanVa.before: Back on VERMILION HARBOR?\nThen we battle again!$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborFishermanVa.after: I've filled another page with\ncatches. Your team deserves a\ppage too!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerDane.after: I swim short lengths between\nrests on shore. Fast isn't much\puse if you can't get back!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerDane.before: VERMILION HARBOR has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerDane.after: Boats need room to turn. I stay\nwell clear of their route, even\pon a good day.$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerDane.before: Back on VERMILION HARBOR?\nThen we battle again!$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerDane.after: Rested, warmed up, ready! Let's\nmake this a good length!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerLina.after: I can float without making a\nripple. My POKéMON aren't nearly\pso quiet!$
So much for a quiet swim!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerLina.before: VERMILION HARBOR has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerLina.after: Lie back and listen. The ropes\ncreak, the gulls call... The\pharbor has a rhythm.$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerLina.before: Back on VERMILION HARBOR?\nThen we battle again!$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSwimmerLina.after: I heard your splashes coming.\nOur quiet break is over!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorPax_T.after: I tie knots aboard ship. In\nbattle, I like leaving my\popponent in a tangle!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorPax_T.before: VERMILION HARBOR has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorPax_T.after: A knot should hold under strain,\nthen loosen when you need it.\pThat's a useful lesson ashore.$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorPax_T.before: Back on VERMILION HARBOR?\nThen we battle again!$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorPax_T.after: No loose ends in our plan today!\nLet's see you untie it!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorMorga.after: I watch the treeline to judge\nthe wind. A sailor needs more\pthan a view of the waves!$
A change of wind caught me!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorMorga.before: VERMILION HARBOR has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorMorga.after: Those trees mark the eastern\nshore. After a long voyage,\pgreen is a welcome sight.$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorMorga.before: Back on VERMILION HARBOR?\nThen we battle again!$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorMorga.after: Leaves fluttering, pennants\nflying... A fine breeze for\panother match!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorRafe_.after: Loading cargo taught me to share\nthe weight. My team knows how to\ppull together!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorRafe_.before: VERMILION HARBOR has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorRafe_.after: The smallest deckhand can spot a\nslipping rope. I listen when\panyone calls out.$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorRafe_.before: Back on VERMILION HARBOR?\nThen we battle again!$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborSailorRafe_.after: All hands ready! We've learned\nto answer each other faster!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteS.after: I practise changing from a swim\nto a run. The first few steps\palways feel strange!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteS.before: VERMILION HARBOR has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteS.after: I lay out my shoes before\nswimming. Finding them shouldn't\pbe the hardest part of training.$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteS.before: Back on VERMILION HARBOR?\nThen we battle again!$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteS.after: Shoes ready, breath steady. This\ntransition includes a battle!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteR.after: I'm working on even splits.\nStarting too fast cost me my\plast race. Race my team instead!$
I spent too much too soon!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteR.before: VERMILION HARBOR has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteR.after: I measure progress by what I\nhave left at the finish, not how\pI feel at the start.$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteR.before: Back on VERMILION HARBOR?\nThen we battle again!$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteR.after: I've saved something for the\nfinal stretch this time!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteE.after: My partner sets our training\npace. Today it wants to stop and\pchallenge you!$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteE.before: VERMILION HARBOR has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteE.after: Some days we train hard. Other\ndays we walk along the trees.\pRest is part of getting\nstronger.$

WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteE.before: Back on VERMILION HARBOR?\nThen we battle again!$
WatersEdge_EventScript_HarborTriathleteE.after: My partner spotted you again. I\nthink it wants a rematch!$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_NI.before: This BUG CATCHER knows\nVIRIDIAN FOREST well!$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_NI.after: See that curled leaf? Something\nbuilt a shelter inside it! My\pbugs have a surprise too!$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_NI.before: VIRIDIAN FOREST has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_NI.after: I leave curled leaves alone. I'd\nhate someone tearing down my\proof to say hello.$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_NI.before: Back on VIRIDIAN FOREST?\nThen we battle again!$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_NI.after: I found more leaf shelters! My\nteam has been busy growing too!$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_CED.before: This BUG MANIAC knows\nVIRIDIAN FOREST well!$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_CED.after: I compare the patterns on shed\nskins. No two finds are quite\palike. Let me study your team!$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_CED.before: VIRIDIAN FOREST has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_CED.after: An empty shell isn't a dead bug.\nIt may be proof that something\pis still growing.$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_CED.before: Back on VIRIDIAN FOREST?\nThen we battle again!$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_CED.after: New notes, new questions. Shall\nwe test another theory?$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_HA.after: I keep fallen branches off the\ntrail. A clear path protects the\pplants beside it. Ready for a\nfield test?$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_HA.before: VIRIDIAN FOREST has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_HA.after: I move a branch only as far as I\nneed to. Something may still be\pliving beneath it.$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_HA.before: Back on VIRIDIAN FOREST?\nThen we battle again!$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_HA.after: The trail is clear again. Let's\ncheck how your team is doing!$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_E.after: My young POKéMON startle at\nrustling leaves. We take little\pwalks to build their confidence.$
They stayed brave to the end!$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_E.before: VIRIDIAN FOREST has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_E.after: I let them investigate a sound\nbefore moving on. Confidence\pgrows faster than orders can\nforce it.$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_E.before: Back on VIRIDIAN FOREST?\nThen we battle again!$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_E.after: They recognised your footsteps!\nWould you help with another\plesson?$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_TO.before: This BUG CATCHER knows\nFUCHSIA FOREST well!$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_TO.after: I found a bug clinging under a\nwet leaf. It didn't slide off\ponce! My team can hang on too!$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_TO.before: FUCHSIA FOREST has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_TO.after: I check underneath leaves after\nrain. There's a whole forest you\pmiss by looking down.$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_TO.before: Back on FUCHSIA FOREST?\nThen we battle again!$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_CATCHER_TO.after: We've practised holding on! Try\nshaking our team this time!$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_QUI.before: This BUG MANIAC knows\nFUCHSIA FOREST well!$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_QUI.after: Hear that clicking? I record\nwhich bugs answer each other.\pLet's see how your team\nresponds!$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_QUI.before: FUCHSIA FOREST has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_QUI.after: One call can set the whole patch\nbuzzing. I wait quietly to hear\pwho starts it.$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_QUI.before: Back on FUCHSIA FOREST?\nThen we battle again!$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_BUG_MANIAC_QUI.after: I learned another call. Now I\nwant to hear your battle\pcommands!$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_RE.after: I check the trees along the\npaths from FUCHSIA. Show me that\pyou and your team can travel\ntogether.$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_RE.before: FUCHSIA FOREST has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_RE.after: I look for fresh damage after\nstrong winds. A familiar path\pstill deserves a fresh look.$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_RE.before: Back on FUCHSIA FOREST?\nThen we battle again!$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_RANGER_RE.after: Your team looks well rested.\nReady for another patrol test?$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_W.after: I brought my POKéMON out of the\ncity to explore. New smells can\pbe quite an adventure!$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_W.before: FUCHSIA FOREST has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_W.after: I let them choose which scent to\nfollow, then call them back.\pThey learn that exploring\ndoesn't mean being alone.$

EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_W.before: Back on FUCHSIA FOREST?\nThen we battle again!$
EventScript_ForestTrainer_PKMN_BREEDER_W.after: They remembered this path! Let's\nsee what else they remember!$

EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_STAN.before: This RUIN MANIAC knows\nCERULEAN CAVE well!$
EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_STAN.after: These marks show where the water\nonce reached. Shall we compare\pwhat our teams have learned?$

EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_STAN.before: CERULEAN CAVE has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_STAN.after: Water leaves evidence long after\nit moves on. I sketch the marks\pbefore the next flood changes\nthem.$

EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_STAN.before: Back on CERULEAN CAVE?\nThen we battle again!$
EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_STAN.after: I found a higher water mark.\nPerhaps your team has reached\pnew heights too!$

EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_FOST.before: This RUIN MANIAC knows\nCERULEAN CAVE well!$
EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_FOST.after: Look at the bands in this stone!\nEach layer formed differently.\pMy battle plan has layers too!$

EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_FOST.before: CERULEAN CAVE has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_FOST.after: A loose fragment tells only part\nof the story. I record where it\pcame from before picking it up.$

EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_FOST.before: Back on CERULEAN CAVE?\nThen we battle again!$
EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_FOST.after: I've revised my notes and my\nstrategy. Let's compare them\pagain!$

EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_LARR.before: This RUIN MANIAC knows\nCERULEAN CAVE well!$
EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_LARR.after: Something disturbed these deep\nrocks. I'm tracing the\pfractures. Your team looks like\na force worth studying!$

EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_LARR.before: CERULEAN CAVE has more to teach\nthan one battle can show.$
EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_LARR.after: The lake hides the ends of these\nfractures. I won't guess what\plies beneath without evidence.$

EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_LARR.before: Back on CERULEAN CAVE?\nThen we battle again!$
EventScript_GymAdjacent_RUIN_MANIAC_LARR.after: The stone hasn't moved, but my\nideas have. Time to test them!$

Route9_Text_BrentRematchIntro.before: I got up early every day to train\nmy POKéMON from cocoons!$
Route9_Text_BrentRematchIntro.after: I've practised my stance on\nloose stone. Try to knock me off\pbalance now!$

Route9_Text_ConnerRematchIntro.before: Go win, my super BUG POKéMON!$
Route9_Text_ConnerRematchIntro.after: I've sharpened my turns on this\nrocky path. Watch my team's\pfootwork!$

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SteveIntro.before: Um… Do you know about POKéMON\ncosplay?$
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_SteveIntro.after: I practise forms by the cave\nechoes. One clean strike should\pmake one clear sound!$

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_StevePostBattle.before: POKéMON cosplay is dressing up as\nPOKéMON for fun.\pCLEFAIRY is a favorite.$
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_StevePostBattle.after: If my feet scrape the stone, I\nstart again. Quiet steps leave\pmore strength for the strike.$

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonIntro.before: I draw illustrations of POKéMON\nwhen I'm home.$
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonIntro.after: I sketch the cracks in these\nwalls. They reveal how the\ptunnel formed. Let's compare our\nobservations!$

RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonPostBattle.before: I'm an artist, not a fighter.\nI'll go home to draw.$
RockTunnel_B1F_Text_WinstonPostBattle.after: A sketch makes me notice what I\nwould walk past. Battle reveals\pgaps in my thinking too.$

Route2_Text_JonahIntro.before: The forest gate is close.\pIf you can handle my bugs, you can\nhandle the path ahead!$
Route2_Text_JonahIntro.after: The forest entrance is close. If\nyou can handle my bugs, you can\phandle the path ahead!$

Route2_Text_JonahRematchIntro.before: You've crossed the forest gate\nbefore.\pLet's see if my bugs can still\nslow you down!$
Route2_Text_JonahRematchIntro.after: You've crossed beneath those\ntrees before. Let's see if my\pbugs can still slow you down!$

Route17_Text_NikolasPostBattle.before: I got my VOLTORB at the abandoned\nPOWER PLANT.\pIt likes this road's constant\nmotion as much as I do.$
Route17_Text_NikolasPostBattle.after: I caught VOLTORB before the\nPOWER PLANT reopened. It likes\pthis road's constant motion as\nmuch as I do.$

EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_JOHAN_Te.after: The noise from SAFFRON makes it\nhard to hear a single thought.\pCan you focus on one command?$

EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_JOHAN_Te.before: You know the path\nbetter than I thought!$

EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_JOHAN_Te.after: I close my eyes and picture this\nroad. The footsteps tell me\pwhich way people are heading.$

EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_JOHAN_Te.before: The paths around SAFFRON\nare clear in my mind!$
EventScript_GymAdjacent_PSYCHIC_JOHAN_Te.after: I recognised your steps this\ntime. Let's see if I can predict\pyour moves!$

EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE11_POKEMAN.before: All the MR. MIME have withdrawn\nfrom the area!$
EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE11_POKEMAN.after: I study MR. MIME, but they've\nall withdrawn into DIGLETT'S\pCAVE! Perhaps a battle will\nclear my head.$

EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE11_POKEMAN.before: All the MR. MIME have withdrawn\nfrom the area!$
EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE11_POKEMAN.after: Still no sign of the wild MR.\nMIME. My own partner is eager to\psee you again, though!$

Route17_EventScript_Milo_Text_Intro.before: I race beside the BIKERS until\nmy legs give out.\pIf you want past me, battle first!$
Route17_EventScript_Milo_Text_Intro.after: I ride beside the BIKERS until\nmy legs ache. My team still has\penergy for you!$

Route17_EventScript_Milo_Text_RematchInt.before: Back for another downhill race?\pGreat! I'll battle before my\nnext sprint.$
Route17_EventScript_Milo_Text_RematchInt.after: Chain checked, tyres ready. One\nbattle before my next ride!$

Route17_EventScript_Mina_Text_Intro.before: Near the bottom, everyone thinks\nthe race is over.\pThat's when I sprint ahead!$
Route17_EventScript_Mina_Text_Intro.after: Near the bottom, everyone stops\npedalling. That's when I put on\pa final burst!$

Route17_EventScript_Nico_Text_Intro.before: Everyone says CYCLING ROAD is\nfor BIKERS.\pI'm proving runners can keep up!$
Route17_EventScript_Nico_Text_Intro.after: Running and swimming can wait.\nToday I'm working on my cycling!\pTry to match our cadence!$

Route17_EventScript_Nico_Text_PostBattle.before: If I can keep my footing here,\nFUCHSIA's flat roads will feel\neasy.$
Route17_EventScript_Nico_Text_PostBattle.after: I keep my pedals turning evenly\nover the rough patches. A steady\peffort gets me farther.$

Route17_EventScript_Nico_Text_RematchInt.before: Back for another downhill race?\pGood! I've still got breath for\none more battle.$
Route17_EventScript_Nico_Text_RematchInt.after: I've ridden the downhill stretch\nagain. Let's test my team's\pfinish!$

EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_TRIATHL.before: This slope is my training route.\pKeep up if you can!$
EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_TRIATHL.after: I practise keeping my wheels on\na clean line. My POKéMON train\pfor precise moves too!$

EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_TRIATHL.before: Back for another downhill run?\pGood. Keep your cadence steady!$
EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_TRIATHL.after: Another downhill ride is done.\nTime to test that steady\pcadence!$

Route17_EventScript_June_Text_Intro.before: I brought picnic food, but the\nwind keeps trying to steal it.\pA battle is easier to hold onto!$
Route17_EventScript_June_Text_Intro.after: My food is strapped to the bike,\nbut the wind keeps pulling at\pthe bag! Let's stop for a match.$

Route17_EventScript_June_Text_PostBattle.before: The grass beside the road is\ncalmer than the pavement.\pThat's why I stay near the edge.$
Route17_EventScript_June_Text_PostBattle.after: I eat before the last climb. An\nempty stomach makes for heavy\ppedals.$

EventScript_RouteTrainer_ROUTE17_TRIATHL.after: A new riding time to beat! Can\nmy team finish as strongly?$

Route3_Text_YoungsterMiaRematchIntro.after: Josh says I've improved my\ntiming. Help me prove it!$

Route4_Text_YoungsterEllaRematchIntro.after: My team is braver on this rocky\nroad now. Let's try again!$

Route7_Text_YoungsterRubyRematchIntro.after: Chad and I tried a new training\nplan. Want to see my results?$
